summary: Robotics programmer, computer technician, and A/V technician based in Bonners Ferry, Idaho. I write robot software for FRC Team 2130 Alpha, run live sound and lighting for theater events, and repair electronics for people in my community.

experience.role: FRC Robotics Programmer and CAD Team
experience.desc: Lead programmer on a competitive FRC robotics team. Responsible for the full software stack on the 2026 season robot, including swerve drive, autonomous path planning, and vision-based target tracking. Worked in a six-subsystem command-based architecture with WPILib Java, integrated PhotonVision across dual cameras, and built autonomous routines using PathPlannerLib. Also managed driver-station tooling through SmartDashboard.

Operate live sound, lighting, and projection systems for performances and events. Responsible for pre-show setup, live mixing, and post-event teardown. Comfortable with both front-of-house and monitor mixing, and coordinating with production staff.
Repaired many devices for members of the community, including Android and Apple smartphones, Apple and Windows personal computers, and other electronics.

services.desc: Repair and upgrade of smartphones, laptops, desktops, audio systems, and gaming consoles. Happy to help set up new technology and transfer data between devices. Works on any brand or operating system.
Prints items up to 200 × 200 × 200 mm, limited to 10 items per order. Basic 3D modeling available if needed.

Full production support for live events: front-of-house sound, monitor mixing, stage lighting, and projection. Experienced with setup, operation, and teardown for performances of varying scale. Client provides equipment (mics, sound board, speakers).
